stories.title: Polisi tangkap sindikat maling "geser tas" dengan korban WN China di Bekasi

en.title: Police arrest bag-snatching gang with Chinese national victim in Bekasi
en.summary: Metro Bekasi Police and national crime unit officers arrested four suspects operating a theft ring that targeted victims using a bag-snatching method, with a Chinese national among those affected.

stories.title: 2 Jasad Korban Kapal Virgo Ditemukan di Seruyan Kalteng

en.title: 2 Bodies of Virgo Ship Victims Found in Seruyan, Central Kalimantan
en.summary: Two bodies from the Virgo Transport 8 ship accident were discovered in Seruyan, Central Kalimantan, with identification procedures underway at a naval post in Kumai.

stories.title: Seorang Warga Sumba Barat Daya Dilaporkan Meninggal Akibat Gempa

en.title: Southwest Sumba Resident Reported Dead from Earthquake
en.summary: A 73-year-old resident of North Kodi in Southwest Sumba died as a result of an earthquake, according to local police authorities.

stories.title: BMKG sebut kualitas udara di Palembang di level sangat berbahaya

en.title: BMKG reports air quality in Palembang at extremely hazardous level
en.summary: Indonesia's meteorology and geophysics agency reported that air quality in Palembang, South Sumatra, has reached extremely hazardous levels.

stories.title: Update Gempa M 6,1 Sumba Barat Daya: 20 Rumah Rusak, 1 Warga Luka

en.title: Update on M 6.1 Southwest Sumba Earthquake: 20 Houses Damaged, 1 Resident Injured
en.summary: A magnitude 6.1 earthquake struck Southwest Sumba, damaging 20 houses and religious facilities. One person sustained minor injuries and there were no fatalities.

stories.title: Seorang warga di Sumba Barat Daya meninggal dunia akibat gempa

en.title: A Resident in Southwest Sumba Dies Due to Earthquake
en.summary: A 73-year-old elderly resident in Southwest Sumba died as a result of the earthquake, according to reports from local police authorities.

stories.title: 20 Rumah Rusak Imbas Gempa Sumba Barat Daya NTT, 1 Orang Luka

en.title: 20 Houses Damaged from Southwest Sumba Earthquake NTT, 1 Person Injured
en.summary: An earthquake in Southwest Sumba, East Nusa Tenggara damaged 20 houses and places of worship. One person suffered minor injuries and conditions are now stable, though aftershocks are possible.

stories.title: Kabut Asap Selimuti Palembang, Kualitas Udara Masuk Kategori Berbahaya

en.title: Haze Blankets Palembang, Air Quality Enters Dangerous Category
en.summary: Forest and land fires have caused haze to cover Palembang with air quality reaching dangerous levels, recording a pollution index of 780.

en.title: Marc Marquez wins 2026 MotoGP Japan
en.summary: Marc Marquez, riding for Ducati Lenovo Team, won the 2026 MotoGP race held at Mobility Resort Motegi circuit in Japan.

stories.title: Indonesia Raih 39 Medali, Lewati Target, dan Buat Rekor Asian Games

en.title: Indonesia Achieves 39 Medals, Exceeds Target and Sets Asian Games Record
en.summary: Indonesia's delegation secured 39 medals at the 2026 Asian Games, surpassing its target and establishing a new record for the country.

stories.title: FOTO: Spanyol Sempurna di Tiga Laga UEFA Nations League

en.title: Spain Perfect in Three UEFA Nations League Matches
en.summary: Spain's national team continued its winning streak following its world championship victory, with the Czech Republic as its latest opponent.

en.title: 2 Men Arrested After Alleged Indecent Act at Manggarai Station Toilet
en.summary: Two men were detained at Manggarai Station following allegations of indecent behavior in a restroom, prompting KAI Commuter to remind passengers of conduct standards.

en.title: Video: Labor Ministry Uses Research and Data to Determine Wages - Job Openings
en.summary: Indonesia's Labor Ministry employs research and data-based methods to establish wage standards that support a decent living for workers.

en.title: Gen Z Starting to Abandon Smartphones, Moving Together to Its Replacement
en.summary: A growing trend shows Generation Z users switching away from smartphones to simpler mobile phone alternatives.

en.title: Bobby Nasution Firmly Chooses Gerindra After Being Expelled from PDIP
en.summary: North Sumatra Governor Bobby Nasution reaffirmed his commitment to the Gerindra Party and rejected switching parties following his expulsion from PDIP.

stories.title: Hasil Akhir Perolehan Medali Asian Games 2026, RI Kalah dari Malaysia

en.title: Final Medal Count Results for Asian Games 2026, Indonesia Loses to Malaysia
en.summary: China won the 2026 Asian Games with Indonesia finishing 16th overall, earning 39 medals in the competition.

stories.title: Iran Tegas Tutup Selat Hormuz sampai AS Penuhi Syarat

en.title: Iran Firmly Closes Strait of Hormuz Until US Meets Conditions
en.summary: Iran states it will close the Strait of Hormuz until seven conditions presented to the United States are met. Iran's parliament leader asserts that the negotiation period has ended and is prepared to take action if necessary.
